segments.text: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
And Abram said,

segments.speaker: Abram
segments.text: Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
And Abram said,

segments.speaker: Abram
segments.text: Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
And he brought him forth abroad, and said,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them:
and he said unto him,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: So shall thy seed be.
And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
And he said unto him,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
And he said,

segments.speaker: Abram
segments.text: Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
And he said unto him,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
And he said unto Abram,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

footnotes: a burning lamp: Heb. a lamp of fire

segments.text: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
